description: Rémi - Points arrêt routiers sur les lignes régulières - CA Territoires Vendômois is a dataset listed in data.vendome.catv open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Centre-Val de Loire. Ce jeu de données est supprimé car plus maintenu. Il est remplacé par: REMI- points d'arrêts sur les lignes régulières. Coverage: Territoires Vendômois (Loir-et-Cher). The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are mobilité, Rémi, transport, interurbain, lignes régulières, déplacements. The portal shows 1,904 records. The portal shows 2025-09-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-vendome-catv41-centrevaldeloire-portal.
